map.毛利和净利区别？: What is the difference between gross and net profit?
map.毛利扣直接成本，净利再扣税费与摊折；本工具算到毛利级，净利以财务账为准。结果仅供: Gross profit deducts direct costs, while net profit also deducts taxes and amortisation; this tool stops at gross profit, so net profit should come from your financial accounts. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.平台佣金是变动成本，应计入单品成本，否则毛利虚高。结果仅供电商运营测算、选品与决: Platform commission is a variable cost and should be included in the unit cost, otherwise gross profit looks inflated. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.费率高就亏？: Does a high cost ratio mean a loss?
map.高费率伴随高周转可能仍盈利，要看费效比与复购，单看费率会误判。结果仅供电商运营测: A high cost ratio with high turnover can still be profitable; look at cost-effectiveness and repeat purchases, since the ratio alone can mislead. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
